stories.title: Maksim Vladimirovich Poletaev v. Uzbekistan — new case registered at ICSID
stories.summary: Maksim Vladimirovich Poletaev and Solfy RUS, Russian investors, have registered a claim at ICSID against Uzbekistan under the BIT Russian Federation - Uzbekistan 2013, in the finance sector. Amsterdam & Partners LLP and E L W I act for the claimants. Ministry of Justice, Department on Legal Protection of Interests of Uzbekistan for Uzbekistan. The tribunal has not yet been constituted.
counsel: Ministry of Justice, Department on Legal Protection of Interests of Uzbekistan, Tashkent, Uzbekistan

enforcement.title: Energía y Renovación v. Guatemala — energía y Renovación Holding S.A. files a counter-memorial on annulment
enforcement.summary: Energía y Renovación brought the claim against Guatemala under the FTA Central America - Panama 2002, in the electric power and other energy sector; it was registered on 29 October 2025. Hogan Lovells Cadwalader US LLP acts for the claimant. Ministry of Economy, Guatemala City, Guatemala, Procuraduría General de la Nación, Guatemala City, Guatemala and Three Crowns for Guatemala. The tribunal is Paul Arrighi Bustamante, presiding; Ximena Herrera-bernal; Attila Massimiliano Tanzi. On 21 September 2026, energía y Renovación Holding S.A. files a counter-memorial on annulment.
counsel: Hogan Lovells Cadwalader US LLP, Miami, FL, U.S.A.
